hierarchy_oracle.definition: For every explicit name and index in each real CSV row, expected ancestors come from the row up to the finest explicit occurrence of that identity; finer unspecified descendants are unavailable. Expectations merge only compatible row facts.
hierarchy_oracle.results: All real name/index ancestors and unavailable descendant queries match
hierarchy_oracle.prefix_test: Default dual aggregation retains CL_Pi/CR_Pi/SL_Pi/SR_Pi separately; explicit strip_prefixes=True merges them into Pi as documented

branch_oracle.definition: Independently enumerate maximal edge chains between graph degree changes; derive node order from branching ancestors and DFS order from child ordinal paths
cases: comb with 1200 fork levels and 2401 nodes
256 random valid trees with unsorted noncontiguous IDs and shuffled source order
branch_oracle.results: Exact branch lists, DFS order and node orders match; every source edge appears exactly once

prefix_callsite_review.main_scripts/region_analysis/hierarchy.p: Explicit strip_prefixes=False for hierarchy output columns
prefix_callsite_review.scope: Python files outside notes/tests/neuron-vis scanned for explicit strip_prefixes=True and strip-prefix helper callers
prefix_callsite_review.remaining_scope: Old split-export stripping/log-before-aggregation defects are separately parent-owned; this review does not accept their old behavior or amend them

limitations: Valid graph software behavior does not establish terminal arbors, anatomy or registration acceptance
Explicit prefix-stripping API remains lossy and must not precede laterality/domain split
